axes.cross_domain_definition: Joint articulation vs. seamless monolithic skin
Machined tolerance vs. weathered patina & erosion
Expansive negative space vs. high-density layering
Freeform biomorphic curves vs. orthogonal modular grid
Overcast softbox diffusion vs. high-contrast chiaroscuro
Low-saturation tonal minimalism vs. vivid complementary tension
Clinical cool detachment vs. tactile warm intimacy
Physical optical realism vs. flattened graphic abstraction

tectonic_honesty.salience_gating_rule: Set salience <= 0.25 for pure 2D flat graphics or tight macro surface textures lacking identifiable structural seams, joints, or load-bearing assemblies; set salience >= 0.80 when cladding joints, fasteners, framing members, or monolithic skin continuity are prominent.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Zero visible seams, fasteners, or structural hierarchy; continuous sculptural plaster, molded shell, or seamless unibody housing.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Seamless curved stucco pavilion; molded unibody matte resin shell; seamless draped cloak.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Predominantly smooth continuous surfaces interrupted only by hairline shadow-gap recesses (<3mm) or concealed clips.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Unibody acoustic speaker; flush curtain wall with hidden mullions; slip-cast porcelain vessel.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Primary load-bearing posts or structural ribs remain readable while secondary infill panels sit cleanly within the frame.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Timber post-and-infill plaster wall; framed leather-and-metal camera body; mortised tea cabinet.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Deliberate 10–20mm panel reveal joints, expressed sub-frames, bolted base plates, or visibly layered garment seams.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Dry-hung Corten steel cladding; modular field rack with bolted rails; taped seam technical shell jacket.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 完全结构外露与机械咬合
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Every structural rod, pin clevis, tension wire, hex fastener, and load path is foregrounded as the primary visual rhythm.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: CNC anodized modular synthesizer; tension-cable truss canopy; raw skeleton watch movement.

surface_entropy.salience_gating_rule: Set salience >= 0.85 whenever surface finish (mirror polish, bead-blasting, concrete pores, patina, kiln ash glaze) occupies >30% of visual attention; lower to <= 0.25 only for pure vector flat art.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Sub-micron surface uniformity, sharp specular reflections, zero micro-scratches, pores, or organic irregularity.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Precision optical lens barrel; electroplated aerospace titanium; gloss ceramic glaze.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 微喷砂哑光工业精加工
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Uniform bead-blasted, brushed, or matte anodized texture with crisp chamfered edges and intentional industrial regularity.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: CNC brushed aluminum workstation; matte polycarbonate housing; calendared cotton poplin.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Natural grain, fine stone honing, or linen weave visible at close range without heavy erosion, rust, or distress.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Honed limestone & oiled walnut; natural woven wool editorial suit; unvarnished hinoki joinery.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 可控粗粝与轻度岁月感
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Board-formed concrete air voids, brushed wire-grain timber, oxidized bronze patina, or natural mineral mottling.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Board-formed architectural concrete; weathered Corten fascia; raw volcanic basalt coastal terrain.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 重度风化窑变与手工时间熵
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Deep pitting, crackle glaze, rough hand-gouged chisel marks, heavy rust oxidation, or thick geological stratification.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Wood-fired Shigaraki ash-crackle stoneware; heavily weathered rammed-earth ruin; raw cast-iron kettle.

spatial_density.salience_gating_rule: Salience is globally observable (typically 0.70–0.95) across all 5 domains by measuring occupied figure area vs. unbroken negative space and foreground/midground/background plane count.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 极高留白与单一视觉孤岛
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: More than 75% unbroken void (sky, blank wall, dark backdrop); single isolated focal silhouette with minimal texture.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Solitary figure on Icelandic black sand; single tea bowl on empty plinth; minimal Swiss poster.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 克制疏朗与清晰呼吸感
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: 50–75% calm breathing room around 2–3 cleanly separated planes or geometric elements; zero visual clutter.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Quiet concrete courtyard; minimal industrial desk object; wide-margin editorial portrait.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 主次均衡的日常构成密度
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Balanced foreground subject and contextual ground (35–50% open space); 3–4 readable sub-components without crowding.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Curated tea alcove arrangement; balanced café storefront elevation; modular typography grid.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 丰富结构与多层次信息排布
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Under 30% open void; dense repetition of dials, louvers, bookshelves, or multi-column typographic annotations.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Calibrated studio rack console; louvered double-skin facade; layered editorial spread.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Edge-to-edge overlapping geometric fragments, multi-plane depth stack, intricate filigree, or dense typographic collage.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Overlapping Constructivist print collage; hyper-layered cyberpunk bazaar; dense schematic poster.

geometric_order.salience_gating_rule: Keep salience >= 0.75 whenever silhouettes, structural grids, or graphic layouts clearly reveal either organic curvature or rectilinear modular control.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Continuous double-curved shells, organic amorphous silhouettes, zero right angles or straight ruler lines.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Parametric fluid concrete shell; sculptural melted glass vase; flowing draped silk silhouette.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 手作微弧与自然非对称
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Hand-thrown irregular curves or relaxed natural drapery tempered by a gentle horizon or plinth line.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Hand-turned stoneware vessel; soft sculpted armchair; botanical shadow study.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Deliberate tension between soft organic forms (human posture, woven drape, cylindrical cup) and architectural straight lines.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Draped coat inside concrete colonnade; circular watch face on chamfered lug case; radial ceramic lid.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Dominant rectilinear massing, consistent column rhythm or beveled industrial chamfers with restrained radii.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Modular timber pergola courtyard; precision camera top-plate; stepped wooden joinery box.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 严苛正交黄金模数网格
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: 100% ruler-straight 90-degree / 45-degree Constructivist axes, modular subdivisions, and disciplined mathematical proportion.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: 12-column Swiss typographic poster; Miesian steel curtain wall bay; grid-aligned modular desk matrix.

lighting_drama.salience_gating_rule: Set salience <= 0.20 for purely flat 2D graphic vector art that has no simulated illumination, cast shadows, or tonal shading gradients.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Omnidirectional softbox or overcast fog light; zero crisp shadow edges; compressed smooth midtone roll-off.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Subarctic overcast fashion shoot; large softbox industrial catalog; foggy courtyard elevation.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Soft directional falloff across surfaces with feathered shadow penumbras and readable shadow detail.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: North-light ceramic still life; diffused shoji screen interior; subtle studio product sweep.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Clear directional key light paired with generous sky/bounce fill (~3:1 contrast ratio); crisp yet gentle shadows.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Afternoon museum courtyard; daylight street storefront; balanced editorial studio setup.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 定向轮廓光与局部高光
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Strong raking light or tight snooted key carving material relief and bright metallic rim highlights against dim ground.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Rim-lit matte black rangefinder camera; raking sunset light on textured plaster; moody editorial profile.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 高反差戏剧性光刀切割
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Extreme >= 8:1 contrast ratio; razor-sharp sunlight slits, deep crushed shadows, or volumetric Tyndall shafts.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Sharp skylight blade across dark concrete hall; dramatic chiaroscuro studio portrait; spotlighted lacquer ware.

chromatic_tension.salience_gating_rule: Salience is globally high (0.80–1.0) across every visual medium because OKLab chroma and hue-angle separation are directly measurable on all pixels.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Zero hue chroma (OKLab C* < 0.015); relies solely on luminance contrast from carbon black to paper white.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Black-and-white basalt editorial; raw charcoal concrete study; pure monochrome Swiss typography.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Muted mineral greys, sage, taupe, or pale slate with narrow hue spread and gentle saturation restraint.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Muted concrete & sage courtyard; matte titanium gray hardware; soft ash linen editorial.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Moderate authentic pigment saturation derived from natural terracotta, walnut, brass, or indigo linen without neon pops.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Smoked oak & terracotta craft table; warm bronze facade detail; editorial camel wool lookbook.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 中性基底 + 单点高纯信号色
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: 75%+ disciplined dark charcoal or off-white ground punctuated by a razor-sharp high-chroma focal accent (signal orange/cobalt).
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Graphite audio device with amber encoder; obsidian space with cinnabar wall; Swiss grid + vermilion bar.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Bold high-chroma fields (ultramarine, vermilion, acid lime, cadmium yellow) colliding across large area ratios.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Bauhaus Constructivist triadic poster; vivid cobalt & tangerine architectural installation.

thermal_mood.salience_gating_rule: Keep salience >= 0.70 across color photography, interiors, hardware, and prints; drop to <= 0.40 only for pure neutral greyscale where thermal cues are intentionally stripped.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: >= 5800K cool blue-cyan cast, surgical steel/glass materiality, razor-sharp sterile precision and emotional distance.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Cleanroom optical bench; icy blue concrete & steel atrium; clinical cyan-silver technical poster.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Cool slate grey, zinc, and overcast daylight tone conveying composed analytical calm without harsh clinical glare.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Nordic slate gallery lobby; matte aluminum camera rig; rainy dusk street lookbook.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Balanced 5000K white point mixing cool mineral stone or metal with subtle warm paper, brass, or skin warmth.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Neutral warm-grey print composition; balanced steel-and-oak desk; crisp studio daylight look.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Warm timber grain, unbleached linen, honeyed paper, and golden-hour bounce invoking approachable human craft.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Hinoki cypress tea vessels; warm sunlit oak bench; tactile cream-paper editorial layout.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Deep amber 2700K–3200K glow, glowing lanterns, terracotta plaster, and cozy tactile embrace.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Dusk amber terracotta tea alcove; candlelit bronze tea kettle; golden-hour wool textile study.

reality_abstraction.salience_gating_rule: Salience >= 0.85 across all assets; separates physical lens-captured micro-realism from stylized illustration, orthographic diagrams, and flat geometric abstraction.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Authentic lens bokeh, optical grain, physically accurate surface micro-imperfections, and real-world atmospheric depth.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Medium-format editorial portrait; real architectural field documentary; unretouched studio macro shot.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Photographic reality with disciplined perspective correction, unified tonal grading, and minimized environmental clutter.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Curated architectural daylight photo; clean editorial product hero shot; minimalist ceramic macro.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 图纸级纯正交实景抽离
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Zero-distortion elevation/isometric framing, hyper-clean studio backdrop, or fine architectural model photography bridging photo and diagram.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Isometric industrial prototype render; monochrome architectural scale model; cyanotype photogram.

anchors.anchor_title_zh: 版画肌理与半调构成转译
anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Recognizable spatial/object motifs distilled into limited ink plates, halftone dots, woodcut grain, or architectural axonometric flats.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Risograph architectural elevation print; layered paper-cut collage; Japanese woodblock abstraction.

anchors.physical_visual_criteria: Zero photographic depth or 3D shading; crisp solid vector planes, typographic blocks, and non-representational rhythm.
anchors.cross_domain_examples: Pure Constructivist red-black-cream vector composition; minimal Swiss typographic poster.
